info.name: Amplitude Attribution Annotations User Mapping API

items.docs: Merge two user identities together by mapping one user_id to another. After mapping, all events and user properties from both identities are consolidated into a single user profile. This is typically used when an anonymous user creates an account.
Reverse a previously created user identity mapping. After unmapping, the two identities are treated as separate users again. This does not retroactively separate events that were already merged.
